reviews.t: Wow, super-heavy and solid!  This extra "arm" really works!
reviews.x: I admit that I felt silly buying this...but I HATE to blow-dry my hair because I have very thick, wavy, and frizz-prone hair.  So usually when I blow-dry it, I can't use the brush properly like a hairdresser would to really work the frizz out and dry it properly and it ends up look dry and poofy until the next day when it settles down.  I typically let my hair just wet-dry and then style with some cream and a curling iron to smooth my ends.  But when I saw this, I just had to try it despite havi

reviews.t: Saves me at least 15 minutes getting ready in the mornings
reviews.x: This is a wonderful invention!  I have a hard enough time getting ready in the mornings without having to spend time drying my hair.  I have very thick hair, when it was long it would take around 35 minutes to dry, and now it is very short and still takes 15 minutes to dry.  Now, I simply leave the dryer on above me while I put on makeup and get dressed in the bathroom, and that's it!  Anything that saves time is an improvement in life quality, it's been a wise investment. *I paid full price for

I just had rotator cuff surgery and couldnt move my shoulder.  This product held my hair dryer with no problems.  I highly recommend it even if both arms work. I will contunue to ise it after my recovery.

I have only had the holder a few days but really love it. I injured my shoulder and this makes doing my hair a manageable task again. The suction cup holds tightly to my mirror and the dryer blows down so that I can easily maneuver to all areas of my head. I added a mirror to my bathroom door so I can see the back of my hair, and a small suction held hook to the mirror to hold the dryer cord neatly out of the way. I would recommend this for anyone.

The mount is very well made and hold very securely to my bathroom mirror. It's easy to position and it holds it's position until I move it. It's easy to strap my dryer in and remove it after each use. The bungee strap holds my dryer securely in place. This dryer stand is very helpful to me. Without it I get a lot of tension and cramps in my neck and wrist. I'm so glad I got this. It makes drying my hair fast, easy and painless.

This was a great purchase and really helps me get my hair dried faster.  I have long fine hair and a lot of it, by having both hands free I can really work my brushes and move my hair around to get it dried quickly.  My only wish is that I would be able to leave my hair dryer strapped in and stored on my wall but after one try it fell down.  But it only takes a minute to get it all set up and has started to really save me a lot of time getting ready in the morning.

reviews.t: Don't waste your time or money
reviews.x: Complete junk!  Now don't get me wrong, good construction and suction "seems" to be strong but don't be fooled!!! I have smooth walls, it holds the blow dryer well and I was excited to use HOWEVER, after it was on the wall for 2 hours it came crashing down onto my title floor and shattered my blow dryer.  And no, I'm not taking it off the wall every time I'm done using it!  Not going to happen.  It's going back period

reviews.t: Works if you have two hands to attach & detach, each time you use it.
reviews.x: I purchased this because I am having hand surgery on my dominate hand and will be in a cast from first knuckle to elbow and will need help drying my hair. I was disappointed when I tried multiple surfaces in my home and nothing but the bathroom mirror will hold this product. ( I do not have glass shower doors which is also an option). This will only work for me if I can leave it attached to the mirror which will interfere with others use of the mirror. Also,I will not be able to attach & detach

reviews.t: I love the product but the suction cup piece doesn't work ...
reviews.x: I love the product but the suction cup piece doesn't work very well. It stayed on our mirror for a while but fell down in the middle of the 3rd night or so (which scared us to death). I ended up drilling holes through the plastic piece & suction cup into an adjacent wall/stud and screwed it into the wall. Works great now! The flexible part holds the hair dryer in the place where you move it to for hours at a time, or longer, which is plenty of time to dry your hair!

reviews.t: Does NOT adhere to any surface.
reviews.x: This item does not stick to any surface. I tried every surface including my mirror and it fell off everyone. I did not send it back because the dryer holder is fabulous, I had my husband make me a structure that held the base and allowed for me to screw it in a wall stud. It works great now but please be mindful that the suction device DOES NOT stick or hold on any flat surface.
Bought this because having hand surgery and would not be able to use one hand. Suction did not hold and the tension in the arm did not hold, so would not support the hair dryer. Very disappointed

I have a bad shoulder issue in my dominant arm, so I needed something to hold my hair dryer so I could easily blow dry my hair every day. This is perfect. It suctions to my vanity top and I can leave it there instead of having to put a non-mounting holder away each time. It is very sturdy and I recommend it.
It has helped me when grooming my dogs, I just put the blow dryer in the holder and then have a hand free to brush them. I would recommend to family and friends and would buy again.
Not cool product. It falls all the time. The maximum time for holding was less than one hour.
I returned it because i could'nt adhere to any surface i had.

reviews.t: Incredibly strong suction cup or overly weak mirror?
reviews.x: Put this up at 7pm on an over the door mirror.  I guess that was mistake number one.  Please see picture for what the whole house woke up too at 4:30 am.  We used it once before the mirror broke.  As far as functionality, it did exactly what it is supposed to do. It held the hairdryer perfectly in place and I was able to adjust as needed, although it is a little stiff. The arm is not long enough for it to stick to our over the sink mirror, which may be stronger, and would require my daughter to

reviews.t: Not worth it - get someone to help you with your hair.
reviews.x: It does NOT stay secured to any surface & BE VERY CAREFUL as it will fall, and if you were anywhere near my condition, it could require a visit to the doctor & an x-ray.  It fell on the hand that was operated on - which was out of the way.
This item is very sturdy and hold strong against the surface you choose to mount it to. It works excellent for me with grooming my Pomeranian. I highly recommend it!

reviews.t: Would not stay clamped to granite. Fell over and ...
reviews.x: Would not stay clamped to granite.  Fell over and hit my wife on the head, then proceeded to scrape our newly hung wallpaper.

reviews.t: Can I say I just love the Hands Free Hair Dryer Holder?
reviews.x: Can I say I just love the Hands Free Hair Dryer Holder? Yes, I can! I do love it. I have cerebral palsy and honestly, I stink at fixing my hair while trying to blow dry and use the brush at the same time.  Now all I have to do is position the bendable arm in the right spot, set the speed on my dryer and use my round brush to do its job.  If I am in a hurry I can set the speed to hot and fast but move the arm further away so I am not frying my scalp and hair. If I have a more leisurely amount of

reviews.t: Both the suction cup and the flexible stand are very sturdy. I was worried it might not work with ...
reviews.x: I'm really impressed by this product. I bought this to use with our foster kittens. Having both hands free makes drying the kittens much faster and easier. Both the suction cup and the flexible stand are very sturdy. I was worried it might not work with the fairly large extra-quiet hair dryer I use, but the stand easily supports it and holds it in position.

Great suction.  Recently traveled and couldn't bring the one I have which is on a stand and sort of heavy for travel so, missed the hands free option.  Love that this allows me to pack and go and I can have hands free to style my hair all the time!!!  Mounts to any flat surface so can also be attached to a counter.

reviews.t: Great hands free hair dryer holder
reviews.x: Have used it now for over a month and it is still staying in place.  The suction is very strong that I had to have my husband install for me.  It has been a pleasure to use with grooming my dogs.  I was surprise that it stuck so well to a shelf that just has a smooth painted surface.

Bought this due to the reviewer who said she left it up for two weeks to make sure it would hold.  Ha!  I tried it in multiple locations with multiple wall treatments and it would not hold a suction.  Worried that it would fall and break my countertop.  It's going back.

I purchased this because of shoulder surgery and I tried everything to make this stay on a smooth counter but after a few minutes it would fall off - even with my strong husband locking it down - I wish I'd kept the box so I could return it -it was useless.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the holder sturdy and secure, with the suction cup and bungee strap holding the dryer firmly in place.
Users appreciate having both hands free, which speeds up drying and helps those with shoulder or hand injuries.
A common complaint is that the suction cup fails to adhere or falls off surfaces, sometimes within hours or days.
Some users report the suction only works on certain surfaces, such as a bathroom mirror, and not on others.
Several reviewers note the holder itself is well made and works well once mounted by other means, such as screwing it into a wall.
